text:
Maria L.: Heads up — nightly RAG eval for cohort A dropped recall by ~18% at top-10 vs yesterday. saw this in nightly/2026-03-20. dumped a few bad generations, looks like scoring prefers shorter results now.

Chen W.: any reranker changes pushed last night?

Maria L.: nope, reranker pinned. the only change was new quantized embed build rolled to staging (PR #4127).

Kai N.: link to PR?

Maria L.: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/4127

Sanjay R.: quick numbers: baseline recall@10 was 0.72 -> 0.59 in nightly. nDCG down too. failing prompt examples attached in the eval artifact.

Eva (ML): can you paste the embed vector size from the artifact? the reranker assumes 128 dims.

Maria L.: pasted snippet from the serialized vectors:
```
# head -c 1024 embeds.bin | hexdump -C | head
vector_len=96
num_vectors=45000
format=fp16
```

Chen W.: vector_len=96?? thats wrong. PR said int8 quantization with packing, not dim reduction.

Kai N.: suspect kernel-level packing changed stride and our loader mis-parsed header -> ended up reading 96 values per vec. i'll grep the build logs.

Kai N.: found in the quant build logs: `opt_pack_channels=96 for device sm89` — looks like the new kernel uses 96-channel blocking for perf. The serialization step should reshape/pad to 128 but maybe a codepath missed for fp16 fallback.

Sanjay R.: reranker index expects 128 dims; if downstream code reads 96 values then dot products misaligned — that's likely the recall drop.

Maria L.: reproducing locally: replaced embed vectors with 96-d and reranker returns many low-sim scores. confirmed.

Eva (ML): two failure modes: 1) on-disk header mismatch (bad metadata), 2) deployment used kernel that silently changed layout. we need to check the conversion pipeline.

Chen W.: PR #4127 diff shows a conditional that sets `pack_channels` based on device arch. serialization code does `tensor.view(-1, pack_channels)` w/o storing original dim. bug.

Kai N.: quick mitigation: update serializer to write explicit `orig_dim` in header and validate at load time. i'll open hotfix PR.

Maria L.: can we roll back the staging quant build to previous version while hotfix ships? nightly tests should be re-run.

deploy-bot: rollback scheduled to staging: release-2026-03-19-quant. ETA 10m. :gear:

Sanjay R.: also flagging customer-facing cohorts that might be impacted — will notify CS for any inbound cases.

Eva (ML): longer term: add unit test to pack/unpack that asserts roundtrip dims and a quick eval smoke that runs a small recall check after releases.

Kai N.: opened PR #4132 with header write and validation. small change, tests included. link: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/4132

Chen W.: thanks. once #4132 CI passes, can we run a staged nightly with the corrected build and compare recall? please ping this thread with results.

Maria L.: noted. re-run scheduled after rollback completes. i'll attach diff of failing prompts then.

ops-bot: nightly-eval job rerun queued (job id: nightly-eval-2076543210-2). status: queued.

Maria L.: thanks all. main action items: rollback (deploy-bot), hotfix PR (kai), smoke eval (chen/eva), CS heads-up (sanjay). will follow up with a postmortem if this makes prod.

Chen W.: :eyes: please also check embeddings ingest pipeline — if any other arch-specific packing exists we may hit this again.

Maria L.: agreed. will add checklist to the PR. closing loop after rerun.
